title: C4: key custody (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: users hold their own identity keys; a CORUNDUM operator receives a separate delegated posting key listed in the user's DID document (visible in the did:webvh log) that can sign only the user's public content index (RootManifest); it cannot change the identity, add devices, or act in Agora. Switching operators = remove old posting key, add new one (log entries). Operators no longer receive users' private keys.
notes: Revised 2026-10-18 by agora-pozi.32.11: user still holds identity (update/recovery) keys and the operator never receives them; but the delegated key is now the CORUNDUM IPNS content key, which signs posts and RootManifests (not only the RootManifest), held by the operator by default, self-custody optional.
